entityDescription:

- Automatic analysis and repair of source code using LLMs.
- Creation of custom chatbots and LLMs for access to information.
- Development and optimization of intelligent systems based on Edge Computing.
- Study and improvement of user experience in information systems.
- Study and improvement of interaction through natural language processing.
- Generative artificial intelligence for the optimization of industrial processes.
We have multiple servers with high-performance GPUs capable of handling large AI models.
We can help you:
- Design and develop generative artificial intelligence models to solve different problems.
- Develop customized LLM adapted to solve specific needs, even designed without the need to send information over the network.
- Design the interaction of all types of computer systems.
- Advice, consult and evaluate interfaces and the user experience of computer systems.

entityDescription:
Experience, performance, flexibility - key success factors for your validation process
AneCom AeroTest support international turbomachinery OEM’s in the validation of their technologies, modules and complete products. Our unique in-house Compressor Test Centre started its operation in 2003 and combines 3 different aerodynamic/acoustic test beds in a perfect symbiosis. Besides testing we design and manufacture not only heavily instrumented module test vehicles but also measurement solutions for all types of turbomachinery and its components. 
The portfolio range includes a complete package for test vehicle design and manufacturing, including the procurement of hardware, associated instrumentation application and assembly of the test vehicle, testing and delivery of the test data collected to the customer. Vigorous project management ensures top quality, delivered on time and within budget of such complex projects. The overall project is complemented by our standard, as well as special measurement technology and equipment – from design and application up to data collection during the test. Fan and compressor tests are carried out on one of our three inhouse test beds at the Wildau site. AneCom AeroTest operates two of these test facilities for aerodynamic tests and one for aero acoustic tests in our Anechoic Chamber, measuring approximately 10.000 m³. Combustor and turbine tests are conducted at certified partner facilities within Germany and if required worldwide.

entityDescription:
Core Focus:
Research Engine is a partnership dedicated to advancing the field of additive manufacturing through innovative solutions in material extrusion and the use of high-performance polymers. Our expertise focuses on niche extreme thermoplastics from ultra soft TPEs to high performance materials.
Specialization:
We are pioneers in Fused Granulate Fabrication (FGF), a material extrusion 3D printing technology that utilizes thermoplastic pellets instead of traditional filaments. Our approach is versatile, adaptable to both large-scale industrial applications and small-scale precision manufacturing, allowing us to push the boundaries of what’s possible in additive manufacturing.
Research Engine’s process harnesses all available thermoplastics, from conventional polymers to advanced high-performance materials such as PEEK, and elastomers. We specialize in optimizing these materials for use in demanding environments, including applications requiring high-temperature resistance and extreme flexibility.
Key Areas of Expertise:
- Material Extrusion: Cutting-edge solutions in fused granulate fabrication, offering efficiency and precision in 3D printing.
- High-Performance Polymers: Engineering thermoplastics that withstand extreme conditions, including heat, mechanical stress, and chemical exposure.
- Additive Manufacturing: Focus on advanced 3D printing techniques that deliver high precision, tailored for both prototyping and production-scale use.
- High Temperature Applications: Expertise in materials and processes designed for high-temperature environments, ensuring stability and performance.
- Ultra-Soft & Elastomeric Materials: Precision fabrication of soft, flexible materials for specialized applications (such as large expansion, 3D printed inflatables) requiring adaptability and durability.
- System Modeling & Mechanical Engineering: Integrated design and system modelling capabilities to optimize the entire manufacturing process from material selection to final part production.
Vision:
At Research Engine, our vision is to drive next-generation manufacturing solutions by enabling the use of advanced materials and innovative extrusion technologies. We are committed to pushing the limits of 3D printing and transforming how industries approach high-precision fabrication.
By combining our expertise in high-performance materials and fused granulate fabrication, we aim to deliver practical, scalable solutions that meet the complex needs of aerospace, automotive, medical, and industrial sectors.

entityDescription:
From a European initiative supported by the Walloon Government, Multitel was founded in 1995. The research centre¿s activities include applied research as well as business services and consultancy. 

Regarding R&D activities, Multitel¿s multidisciplinary teams of high-skilled engineers develop various applications in the areas of speech and signal processing, image processing, networking and applied photonics with the prototyping and realization of preseries (lasers, amplifiers, fibre sensors); optical metrology (field characterization of optical networks, test and reliability studies of optical subsystems and components, periodic calibration of optical equipment).

Moreover, Multitel is internationally recognized for its active involvement in the European Research Area, with about 20 projects in FP6 (among which 12 are still in progress), three in FP7, as well as in the EUREKA initiative and other national and regional programmes.

In addition to those R&D activities, Multitel organizes trainings and conferences in order to inform people of the latest technology. Multitel is also the first Red Hat certified training centre in Belgium.
